_sourceCategory = Labs/Windows/OS/Windows _sourceName=Security (4946 or 4947 or 4948) ("EventCode = 4946;" or "EventCode = 4947;" or "EventCode = 4948;")
| parse "EventCode = *;" as event_id
| parse "Computer = \"*\";" as host nodrop | parse "ComputerName = \"*\";" as host nodrop
| parse regex "Message = \"(?<msg_summary>[^\r]+?)(?:\r|\.;)" nodrop
| where event_id in ("4946","4947","4948")
